They get around by elevator, a looping metro, buses and taxis, under real traffic lights. Easter eggs included. Three.js and React, in the browser. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic.

1412550573.name: ff-unmute
1412550573.description: This one, you can unmute: a camera flies over a DAW timeline in one shot while a tracker locks onto every beat. Music composed in code, every number measured, all fframes.

1412688824.name: 3DGS-LOD
1412688824.description: Better LOD for web 3DGS: better quality with half the Gaussians. Outputs standard Streamed SOG for PlayCanvas / WebGPU.

1412735077.name: GoStream3D
1412735077.description: GoStream3D：基于 Go、Chromium 与 WebRTC 的交互式 3D 云渲染平台，支持 Linux CPU、NVIDIA/Intel GPU、独立会话、预加载与资源监控。

1412946358.name: eink-deck
1412946358.description: 一个通用 eink 网页 PPT 引擎：输入一份大纲 Markdown，输出一个自包含的 index.html（含全部样式、脚本、字体子集，离线可双击打开）。 引擎 / 模板 / 示例全部随技能自带，不依赖任何具体工作区。
